name: Corazones góticos
source:
Every action, triggers a reaction, so choose your response wisely.

The story centers on Helen, a gothic teenager in love with the brother of her best friend. There are three routes available: Delrick, Eldrich, and Asha.

[Translated from [url=https://seityposa.itch.io/corazones-gticos]Itch.io[/url]]
